6097-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6097-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1170-6573-8210.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone twice this game.
1170-6573-8210.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Konstrari Improviser. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

1339-3394-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3394-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

141-413-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Bond of Revival.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1903-3490-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
1903-3490-7075-7763.description:
Activate an artifact creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2459-4053-6495-6989.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
2459-4053-6495-6989.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

792-2738-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Totentanz, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2511-5233-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

628-2438-7865.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4478-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a number of creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1169-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1169-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
1169-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

2308-4050-4871-6720.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4050-4871-6720.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4316-4871-5220-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4316-4871-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7157.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

730-1479-2841-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
730-1479-2841-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

123-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Highspire Artisan.
When Highspire Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Highspire Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2438-5541-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-1753-2438.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5618-5909.description:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling all but the bottom six cards of each player's library.
Activate Rakdos by sacrificing Doomsday Excruciator.
When Doomsday Excruciator dies, Rakdos's first ability triggers, exiling the top six cards of an opponent's library.
When the opponent targeted in step 4 would draw a card during their next draw step, they will instead lose the game due to having zero cards in their library.
5618-5909.notes: You can repeat steps 3 and 4 using other methods of sacrificing to exile other opponents' libraries. You can also activate Rakdos on subsequent turns to accomplish this. In order for this to work, you'll need to control an extra creature with power 6 or greater for each other opponent you have. Otherwise, this combo will only cause one opponent to have their library exiled and lose the game.

413-4826-5003-6644.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ancient Adamantoise enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

413-654-5003-6644.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ancient Adamantoise enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

4826-5147-5222-6644.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that are untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

2511-6188-6591--85.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
2511-6188-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out's second ability triggers, untapping Squall and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

2468-3094-4276.notablePrerequisites: Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2468-3094-4276.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Turnabout without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all artifacts you xontrol.
Repeat from step 2.

2351-2440-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
2351-2440-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Tentacle you control.
Repeat.

618-2724-3217.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Manta with haste.
The Wormfang Manta token's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
At the beginning of your end step, Kiki-Jiki triggers, causing you to sacrifice Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

413-3451-4191-4784.description:
Cast Augusta from your hand by paying {0} due to Aluren.
When Augusta enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Augusta.
When Augusta dies, Death's Oasis triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Plargg from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

11-2539.notablePrerequisites:
an instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Mana available to cast the instant or sorcery spell.
11-2539.description:
Cast the instant or sorcery spell.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the instant or sorcery spell.
Holding priority, activate twinning staff by paying {7} targeting Narset's Reversal, copying Narset's Reversal twice.
Resolve one copy of Narset's Reversal targeting another copy of Narset's Reversal, copying it twice and returning the targeted copy to your hand.
Repeat step 4.

1987-3075-3573-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.You control at least two artifacts.
1987-3075-3573-4125.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
